name: The Land of Darkness and Light
source:
In a land where truth is hidden in darkness, four friends uncover the mystery of the  things they've been told their whole lives.  In their quest for the truth, will they find what they seek or run back to the comfortable lies with which they've been raised?

[From [url=https://jesusforsinners.itch.io/the-land-of-darkness-and-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这片真相隐藏在黑暗中的土地上，四个朋友揭开了他们一生中被告知的事情的奥秘。在追寻真相的过程中，他们会找到自己想要的东西，还是会回到成长过程中舒适的谎言？

[来自[url=https://jesusforsinners.itch.io/the-land-of-darkness-and-light]Itch.io[/url]]
